broadcastIds.description: Paste broadcast links such as https://x.com/i/broadcasts/1YGNrbPLejQGw, bare broadcast IDs, post links that announce a broadcast, or legacy Periscope links (/v/<id> or /<user>/<id>). Old pscp.tv/w share links cannot be resolved and return a status row.
broadcastIds.title: Broadcast links, IDs or broadcast posts

includeBroadcasterProfile.description: Add the broadcaster's public profile (followers, bio, location, account creation date, pinned posts). Falls back to the compact broadcaster record if the profile is unavailable.
includeBroadcasterProfile.title: Include broadcaster profile

includeChatHistory.description: Collect text messages from the broadcast's public chat replay after it ends. Live chat and private chats are not collected. No text is emitted when the chat only contains join/heart events.
includeChatHistory.title: Include public chat replay

includeReplayVideo.description: Resolve the HLS playback URL and stream status. For a live broadcast the URL is the live stream; for an ended broadcast it is the replay.
includeReplayVideo.title: Include replay video link

includeThumbnail.description: Store the broadcast cover image in the run's key-value store and return its stable URL plus the original X image URL.
includeThumbnail.title: Include thumbnail image

includeViewerStats.description: Include current/total viewers, the viewer-history graph when X exposes it, and derived peak/average viewers. Turn off for a lighter output.
includeViewerStats.title: Include viewer statistics

includeViewerTimeline.description: Push one "viewer timeline point" row per point of the broadcast's viewer-history graph. No rows are emitted when X provides no graph.
includeViewerTimeline.title: Emit viewer timeline points as rows

maxChatMessages.description: Maximum public chat text messages per broadcast. Older events and join/heart events are not counted.
maxChatMessages.title: Max chat messages per broadcast

maxViewerTimelinePoints.description: Maximum timeline rows per broadcast. 0 means all points. When capped, points are evenly sampled across the full broadcast and each row keeps its original index.
maxViewerTimelinePoints.title: Max viewer timeline points per broadcast
